mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% signals an accommodative monetary policy environment that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25% for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals improving labor market conditions, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where UNRATE declines by >0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales (both demand indicators) signals robust consumer spending and economic expansion, which increases corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both rise > 0.1% in 1 month
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS rise > 0.1% in 1 month, S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflationary pressure that may prompt the Federal Reserve to accelerate rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY inflation exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production (a key indicator of manufacturing and supply-side activity) signals expanding economic output, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO growth in the last month is positive but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in > 60% of such months.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP growth rate exceeding 1.5% signals robust economic expansion, which increases corporate profit expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of quarters with GDPC1 QoQ growth > 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 100,000 jobs per month and the federal funds rate remains below 0.5%, it signals a strong labor market without inflationary pressure, which supports equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: labor market strength with accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: When PAYEMS > 100,000 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: In a broad economic recovery (as indicated by positive GDP growth), a monthly increase in housing starts exceeding 0.1% signals strong consumer demand and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST rises > 0.1% in 1 month and GDPC1 QoQ growth is positive, S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of such periods.
